messages.subject: normVarNames not working
parts:
Hi everyone,

I'm trying to use the normVarName() from rattle and it seems this function is not available anymore. I'm using as reference this tutorial here: http://onepager.togaware.com/DataO.pdf 
On page 6 it is used this function above. 

Is there a similar function that does the same thing?

Thanks,
Gabriela

messages.author: 51ea28fc190ac537
messages.subject: Re: normVarNames not working
parts:
That function is certainly in the latest version of rattle (I use it all the time). It is normVarNames() (with an s).

> install.packages("rattle", repos="http://rattle.togaware.com", type="source")
> library(rattle)
> normVarNames(names(weather))

Graham Williams
http://togaware.com
